query: I am a student at a Finnish university. Can I work full-time (40 hours a week) during the autumn holiday?
expected_answer: Yes. During holidays (such as summer or autumn breaks) when the educational institution has no scheduled instruction, there are no hourly limits, and you are allowed to work full-time. During active term time, you are only permitted to work an average of 30 hours per week.

query: I applied for asylum in Finland. I don't have a passport, only an identity certificate. When am I legally allowed to start working?
expected_answer: If you do not have a valid passport or travel document, your right to work starts 6 months after you submitted your asylum application. If you had a valid travel document, you could have started working after a 3-month waiting period.

query: I received a residence permit based on family ties as the spouse of a Finnish citizen. Are there any restrictions on the type of job or the number of hours I can work?
expected_answer: No. A residence permit granted on the basis of family ties gives you an unrestricted right to work in Finland. There are no restrictions on the employment sector, you can work as an employee or an entrepreneur, and there is no limit on your weekly working hours.

query: I have a specialist residence permit. I received a new job offer from a different IT company in Espoo. Do I need to apply for a brand new permit before I can switch?
expected_answer: No, you do not need to apply for a new permit if your current specialist permit is still valid. Under a specialist permit, you can change employers freely as long as your new position also meets the specialist requirements, including high-skilled tasks and meeting the national specialist salary threshold.

query: I entered Finland on a tourist visa waiver. A local cafe wants to hire me as a waiter. Can I start working immediately and submit my application from inside Finland?
expected_answer: No. If you entered Finland as a tourist (either on a visa or visa-free), you cannot begin regular employment, such as working in a cafe, until you have applied for and been granted a residence permit. You must wait for the decision before starting work.

query: My current work permit is set to expire next Tuesday. I already submitted my extended permit application yesterday. Can I keep working while Migri processes it?
expected_answer: Yes. If you submit your application for an extended permit before your previous permit expires, your right to work remains valid and unchanged under the same terms as your previous permit until a decision on your extension is made.
